critical_code_review_comments: TableCard.jsx now 797 LOC (over 700 guideline). Consider splitting aggregator body block (L412-443) and action-buttons block (L445-680) into small subcomponents for maintainability.
Rider status uses raw emoji '👤' string (L439); consider using lucide User icon for consistency with other icons in the card (Bike, etc.) and to avoid emoji cross-platform rendering differences.
MyGenie should include width/height attributes and loading='lazy' to prevent CLS when many delivery cards render (only alt/data-testid present at L320-323).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing preprod aggregator orders 40474-40477 (Swiggy, restaurant 478) and own delivery orders 892353/972255/998007/867887.
